reason: The only complementary data not already presented are either unconsumed and semantically underspecified (ic_feature), context-sensitive and not emitted (FALSE_FRIEND), or absent from the plain-text contract (visual and multimodal evidence). A new panel would add surface area without a sufficiently trustworthy payload.

scope: Prepare one 20-second oral formulation describing the extension as a research perspective.
Prepare one static architecture slide only if already useful to the defense deck.
Do not modify Seven Sieves, Dico-IC, MariaDB, contracts or versions.
acceptance_criteria: The seven sieves remain exactly seven.
The existing reading-aid demonstration remains under 30 seconds.
No non-functional control appears in the learner interface.
The wording separates observed field needs from implemented capabilities.

post_defense_candidate.objective: Design and validate a provenance-aware complementary-enrichment contract before any interface work.
phase_0_human_decisions: Christian: validate whether false-friend alerts are transversal complements and define contextual caution.
Sylvain: validate learner load, vocabulary and voluntary disclosure behavior.
Relevant field specialists: validate image, gesture, oral and cultural categories and ethical constraints.
David: choose one family only for the first experiment.
post_defense_candidate.why_this_family: Eight explicit relations already exist and are more informative than ic_feature risk flags, but they still require context and an API representation.

exact_minimal_scope_if_authorized.data: Use a human-approved subset of existing FALSE_FRIEND relations only; create no new relation automatically.
exact_minimal_scope_if_authorized.backend: Add a distinct, typed complementary enrichment emitted by POST /analysis; do not assign sieve_id and do not overload pedagogical_enrichments without an explicit contract decision.
exact_minimal_scope_if_authorized.session: Transport the new optional array without changing existing sieve results or reading aids.
exact_minimal_scope_if_authorized.student_surface: One collapsed section, hidden by default, visually separate from both the seven sieves and Aides à la lecture.
exact_minimal_scope_if_authorized.teacher_surface: Optional count and explicit enablement for the activity; no hidden activation.
exact_minimal_scope_if_authorized.admin_surface: No new authoring workflow in the first demonstrator; use only approved existing relations.

proposed_public_vocabulary.intro: D’autres repères documentés peuvent compléter l’exploration, sans appartenir aux sept tamis.
proposed_public_vocabulary.reading_aids_distinction: Les Aides à la lecture expliquent les connecteurs du texte ; les repères complémentaires signaleraient d’autres phénomènes validés.
proposed_public_vocabulary.sieves_distinction: Ces repères ne sont ni un tamis supplémentaire ni une étape obligatoire.

tests_required: No eighth sieve and unchanged sieve catalogue 1..7.
Existing token enrichments and pedagogical_enrichments remain byte-compatible for old clients.
FALSE_FRIEND is never converted to a learner alert without exact source-language occurrence, mediation-language counterpart and approved relation.
Contextual caution, provenance and confidence are present.
Panel hidden by default and absent when no valid complement exists.
Reading-aid toggle and complementary toggle are independent.
Teacher/student session transfer preserves the new optional payload.
Escaping and offset validation reject malformed payloads.
Regression suite for analysis lifecycle and role separation.
human_recipe: Prepare one sentence containing an approved false-friend occurrence and one negative/contextual control.
Run the teacher analysis and open the learner activity.
Confirm seven sieves and Aides à la lecture behave unchanged.
Verify the pair, explanation, caution and provenance with Christian or a designated reviewer.
Confirm the negative control shows no alert.
versions_if_implemented: analysis contract or additive capability marker
session format only if backward-compatible optional transport is insufficient
abort_criteria: No recorded human approval of the selected relations and wording.
Need to infer alerts from ic_feature or spelling alone.
False-positive control cannot be expressed or tested.
UI cannot distinguish the panel from Aides à la lecture and the seven sieves.
Demo exceeds 30 seconds or distracts from the stabilized core.
Implementation requires multimodal input or a new data model before the research question is narrowed.
